title: feedback's charter is proved clause by clause
intention: feedback's charter is proved clause by clause: each of its falsifier's eight clauses gets one tooth against the code that stands, and a clause the code does not meet becomes a question to Akien (keep it, and it is a build; or retire it).
why: Measured 2026-11-16: cairn/tools/feedback/intention+why.json was born in cairn 1ef9aa099 (2026-08-14) with no ticket. intention_fidelity (inspector.py:178) pairs it only with f68bd50f2902, a Windows forward-slash fix whose falsifier is invented relative to this charter (0.966 > 0.95). 94e1cce8941e settled decisions/2026-08-21-feedback-is-probes-two-consumer-kinds, not these clauses. test_feedback.py carries 22 checks in one main() and no PROVES block, so no clause is bound to a tooth by name.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing in proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass) and Law 9 (red is the default; green is earned).
how: One proof, cairn/tools/feedback/proofs/test_feedback_charter_holds_clause_by_clause.py, with a PROVES key per clause. Each tooth runs feedback's public functions over a scratch root. Clauses 1-6 and 8 hold and get teeth. Clause 7 is not met as written, so it is Q#116 at outline 17.10.1 (inbox open-17442cfc2096). Keep it and its tooth plus a corpus_record lane are built here; retire it and the clause leaves the charter. feedback.py does not change before that answer.

measured.saw: feedback's charter has no ticket of its own; its only paired ticket is f68bd50f2902 with invented 0.966
measured.how: git log on the charter (born 1ef9aa099); intention_fidelity's pairing

measured.saw: of 63 gate.proved/inspected calls in shipped code, the only route-like keyword is routes_to at cairn/tools/feedback/feedback.py:316; gate.proved (gate.py:108) accepts any keyword into values
measured.how: an AST walk over cairn/ excluding proofs; read gate.proved

measured.saw: the clause proof 7/7 green; seven hollow builds of feedback.py, one per clause, each red the tooth they target (clause 1's as a KeyError crash, the rest by assertion)
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec in worktree wt-fbc; source mutations of feedback.py loaded in place of the module

outcomes.claim: a feedback block with no why, or a blank or whitespace why, is refused by probes() and fails its corpus_record entry
a to that does not resolve on disk is refused by route() and fails its corpus_record entry, never stored
a module that only mentions gate.proved( or inspected( inside a string is not a producer, and one that calls them is
a finding constructed only inside proofs/ does not make its component a producer
a healthy world, every producer routed, yields an all-passing record (one entry per producer) and gate.opens is true
a component that stops constructing findings leaves no entry in corpus_record, rather than a green one
a route is not accepted as a keyword argument at a finding-construction site (waits on Q#116: keep, a build, or retire)
a component that declares no route gets no default destination: route() and probes() raise NoRoute and its entry names no address

outcomes.text: a new proof with one tooth per clause, over scratch roots; test_feedback.py stands unchanged. Clauses 1-6 and 8 are bound now.

clause 7 is asked, not decided: Q#116 at press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt 17.10.1, with the inbox copy open-17442cfc2096 bound here so BUILDME waits. If he keeps it, corpus_record gains a lane that reds a construction site spelling a route keyword (feedback's own routes_to renamed or exempted), plus a tooth keyed 7. If he retires it, the clause leaves the charter's falsifier and this ticket's clause 7 is dropped.
